mode: Chromium DOM integration; page.set_content; Storage and download adapters

Persistence tests validate serialization and rehydration using a Storage-compatible adapter, not disk durability.
Download tests inspect generated Blobs, not OS save dialogs.
No live API, SMS, email or external calendar is connected.
